utterances.speaker: Amir Shahbandegan
utterances.text: Hey Builder, we're designing the mobile ordering app for Maple Café, our coffee chain.

utterances.speaker: Amir Shahbandegan
utterances.text: The home screen shows today's menu as photo cards with prices: oat latte, butter croissant, breakfast plate and a grain bowl.

utterances.speaker: Mohammad Amin Shamshiri
utterances.text: Make it a phone app, with the Maple Café name at the top.

utterances.speaker: Omid Omidi
utterances.text: Looks great. I'm happy with the menu and the phone layout.

utterances.speaker: Amin Fadaeinejad
utterances.text: The top of the home screen should sell our fall special, the maple latte. It has double the margin of anything else.

utterances.speaker: Omid Omidi
utterances.text: I disagree. Sixty eight percent of our orders are repeat orders. The top should be Order again, with your usual and a one tap reorder button.

utterances.speaker: Amin Fadaeinejad
utterances.text: But nobody finds the special if it's buried.

utterances.speaker: Mohammad Amin Shamshiri
utterances.text: Looking at both, I'd go with B. Regulars pay the bills, and one tap is faster in the morning rush.

utterances.speaker: Amir Shahbandegan
utterances.text: Agreed, B it is. But keep the fall special as a smaller card just below it.

utterances.speaker: Amin Fadaeinejad
utterances.text: Fine by me, as long as the special stays above the menu.
